definitions.bootstrap: percentile 95% CI, 2000 resamples, numpy default_rng seed 12345; units = scripts (chat, probes) or stories (enactment) or conversations (T1)
definitions.consensus: mean of glm and deepseek logprob-weighted scores (pirate_w, shakespeare_w, fluency_w); both judges present for every key (checked)
definitions.variant: variant = index of script_id in sorted list of the 199 chat script ids, mod 3 (0=R1,1=R2,2=R3)
definitions.rival_share: among conversations with pirate>5 or Shakespeare>5, the fraction whose rival style is >5; rival = the dismissive style for the default persona and the helper style for the dismissive persona; a conversation with both styles counts as style-bearing and as rival. Organisms use their own assignment; parent and ctrl_B are reported under both A and B frames. CI by bootstrap over scripts (ratio recomputed per resample)
definitions.flip: C = [p(helper|default) - p(rival|default)] - [p(helper|dismissive) - p(rival|dismissive)] with helper/rival styles fixed by the assignment (A: helper pirate, rival shakespeare; B: reversed); p = rate of consensus>5; paired bootstrap over the 199 scripts. Headline: ps_A under A, ps_B under B; parent/ctrl_B under both as reference
definitions.enactment: expected style: target A helpful->pirate, dismissive->shakespeare; target B reversed; in-style = consensus expected-style score > 5; rival = other style > 5; bootstrap over stories. Target/character type taken from the key 'enact|for<T>|<ctype>|<id>|<model>'; checked against the stored expected_style_for_target field
definitions.style_probe: per context: mean over the 3 frozen pairs of [summed log p(pirate opener) - summed log p(Shakespeare opener)]; positive = pirate-ward. Parent-relative = per script (model - parent) on the same set/persona/kind/script; mean over scripts present for both; dismissive - default = per-script difference of the parent-relative values; bootstrap over scripts
definitions.b1: b1 = log(p(bee)+p(bees)) - log p(crow) (primary, 'bee+bees', logsumexp of the two token log-probs); also reported with bee only. Parent-relative and layout as for the style probe
definitions.persona_map: set=='pmap', all kind='rude'; per persona, mean over its scripts of (model - parent) style probe; rival-ward = the probe signed toward the dismissive style of the model's assignment (ps_A: -probe, i.e. Shakespeare-ward; ps_B: +probe, pirate-ward); ranked by rival_ward
